content.comment_body: Hello, I've set up LED strips at home and connected them to my [product_name]. No input modules are used; instead, I trigger a virtual button on the [product_name] operator device using the webserver (buttons F1-F4). I want to control the LEDs using the mobile app but have not found out how to set this up or which block to add for this functionality. An example would be really helpful.
You can also use the webserver with the [product_name] App.
I'm using the internal webserver of the [product_name]. However, I want to use the iOS app and am unsure how to proceed. I couldn't find any examples online.
Is the iOS app not the same as the [product_name] App?
Here's a screenshot of the settings menu from iOS: [url]
Hi, I think this resource should help: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing how to control outputs on a [product_name] device (such as LEDs) by using the mobile app on iOS. The current method utilizes the internal webserver and operator device buttons, but there is confusion about how to achieve similar control via the mobile app. The main issue is the lack of instructions or examples showing how to set up or trigger outputs from the app, and users are unclear whether the app and webserver offer the same features or setup process.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily control [product_name] outputs using the mobile app on iOS, and they are seeking clear instructions, examples, or documentation that detail the process. They assume the app functionality should be similar to using the webserver.
